why: Keep publication refusal and editor recovery consistent when another tab changes a draft during validation.
verdict: pass for map and release source-edit races through public controls
observations: Both dialogs visibly refuse the stale source with readable instructions and usable actions.
Publication LibraryConflict now flags the matching current editor context, updates the header and exposes Save a copy.
Newer draft and package list remain exact after refusal.
Public reload/retry freezes the newer title as version 1; failed attempt consumes no version.
Ordinary two-tab conflict/copy regression passes with and without notifications.
limits: Worker loading delayed intentionally; native validation and actual IndexedDB transactions still run.
Title edit source race, not every simultaneous map regeneration or run checkpoint boundary.
No disk-failure, online collaboration or full-release acceptance claim.
